## Validation

- [ ] Relevant focused tests pass.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] `npm run docs:check` passes when documentation or examples changed.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Public API changes are listed, or there are none.
- [ ] Validation-rule changes include approved sources, evidence level, limitations, and tests, or
      there are none.
- [ ] Runtime dependency changes are justified and explicitly approved, or there are none.
- [ ] The change is limited to the stated scope and does not include unrelated roadmap work.
